description: Protocol-level error reporting: malformed JSON input is reported as a parse error, an empty-line payload is also a parse error, and a request naming an unknown method is reported as method-not-found.

cases.description: malformed JSON yields a parse error
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error

cases.description: empty-line payload yields a parse error
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error
